help.title: About Overview
help.overview: Overview is the company-wide control room for Real Estate. It does not store its own documents. Every number is a live roll-up of Projects, Edifices, Units, Leads, Reservations, Sales, Leases, Rental payments, Snags, and related workflow records. Use it to see whether the portfolio is moving, then jump into the list that actually owns the work.

sections.title: What this page is
items: A read-only cockpit for one company (the company you are signed into).
Tabs are different cuts of the same data: headline KPIs, trends, inventory, and pipeline health.
Nothing you do here creates a Project, Unit, Sale, or Lease. Cards that say “View entries” open the matching operational list with the same idea of filters.
It is not the edifice-level Dashboard (that page is for day-to-day steering of one building) and not the Group dashboard (that page rolls up several companies).
sections.body: Think of Overview as “is the company healthy?” and Dashboard as “what is happening in this building today?”

sections.title: Tabs
items: Overview — mix of available / reserved / sold / rented units, collection, and other headline figures for the selected period.
Analytics — how those figures move over time (period toolbar at the top).
Projects / Edifices / Units — inventory counts and values so you can see where stock sits without opening each list.
Workflows — pipeline health: leads, reservations, inspections, snags and similar in-flight work.
Reports / Notifications (when shown) — shortcuts into reporting and in-app alerts, not separate document types.
sections.body: The period control (7 / 30 / 90 / 12 months) only changes time-bounded KPIs. Unit inventory counts are “now”, not “in that window”, unless the tab says otherwise.

sections.title: How the numbers are produced
items: Sold / reserved / rented come from Unit status, which is moved by Reservations, Sales, and Leases — not typed on this page.
Collected revenue and rent figures come from sale receipts / payment plans and rental payment rows.
Stuck work (overdue rent, expiring reservations, open snags) is a count of those operational records.
Refreshing reloads the aggregation. There is no separate warehouse to “rebuild”.

sections.title: Typical use
items: Start of day: check sold vs available vs rented, overdue rent, and reservations that need attention.
Then open Dashboard for a specific edifice, or jump to Units, Reservations, Sales, or Rentals Hub to act.
Do not try to “fix” a KPI here — change the underlying reservation, sale, lease, or payment.
